independent_read_method: Fresh docker create pinned to the new immutable index; docker cp of thirteen actual ELF files, SHA256 and native Go build info read by this agent. No fixture was started.

baseline_evidence_identity.use: Verifies immutable graph/build provenance and unchanged exact plugin bytes only; no historical verdict/authorization is inherited.

limitations: Only the exact scanner/advisory/target/package/version/severity tuples and actual ELF identities listed in reviewed_rows receive these technical conclusions.
Pclntab is supplemental; inlined-code absence is supported by complete compile-package graphs, never inferred solely from missing function names.
Main Grafana core and all other CVEs are outside this agent review; human exact-subject authorization, final full gate, publication and deployment are separate.
